CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.next_quote_number(account_prefix text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  next_num int;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(
    CAST(SPLIT_PART(quote_number, '-', 2) AS int)
  ), 0) + 1
  INTO next_num
  FROM sales_quotes
  WHERE quote_number LIKE account_prefix || '-%';
  RETURN account_prefix || '-' || LPAD(next_num::text, 4, '0');
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_805_quote_customer_card()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_805_account_id uuid := '72ccf12a-11c0-4261-8ad0-31af8ad0bbfb'::uuid;
  v_job_id uuid;
  v_job_number text;
  v_highest_num bigint := 0;
  v_job_status public.job_status;
  v_product_type public.product_type := 'shutters'::public.product_type;
  v_product_received_at timestamptz := NULL;
  v_now timestamptz := now();
  v_line_items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_total_products integer := 0;
  v_shutter_count integer := 0;
  v_blinds_shades_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.account_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_805_account_id THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.status NOT IN ('sold', 'ordered', 'received', 'installed') THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  v_job_status := CASE NEW.status
    WHEN 'sold' THEN 'waiting_for_product'::public.job_status
    WHEN 'ordered' THEN 'waiting_for_product'::public.job_status
    WHEN 'received' THEN 'all_product_received'::public.job_status
    WHEN 'installed' THEN 'complete'::public.job_status
    ELSE 'waiting_for_product'::public.job_status
  END;

  IF NEW.status IN ('received', 'installed') THEN
    v_product_received_at := COALESCE(NEW.received_at, v_now);
  END IF;

  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_strip_nulls(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'line_number', COALESCE(li.sort_order, 0) + 1,
            'quote_id', li.quote_id,
            'quote_line_item_id', li.id,
            'room_type', li.room_name,
            'room_name', li.room_name,
            'product_name', li.product_type,
            'product_type', li.product_type,
            'description', concat_ws(' ', li.room_name, li.product_type),
            'width', concat_ws(
              '',
              li.width_whole,
              CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(li.width_fraction, ''), '0') <> '0'
                  THEN ' ' || li.width_fraction
                ELSE ''
              END
            ),
            'height', concat_ws(
              '',
              li.height_whole,
              CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(li.height_fraction, ''), '0') <> '0'
                  THEN ' ' || li.height_fraction
                ELSE ''
              END
            ),
            'quantity', COALESCE(li.quantity, 1),
            'designs', COALESCE(
              (
                SELECT jsonb_agg(
                  jsonb_strip_nulls(
                    jsonb_build_object(
                      'variant', d.variant,
                      'product_type', d.product_type,
                      'supplier', d.supplier,
                      'material', d.material,
                      'louver_size', d.louver_size,
                      'tilt_type', d.tilt_type,
                      'hinge_color', d.hinge_color,
                      'panel_config', d.panel_config,
                      'mount_type', d.mount_type,
                      'shade_type', d.shade_type,
                      'lift_system', d.lift_system,
                      'valance', d.valance,
                      'fabric', d.fabric,
                      'motor_type', d.motor_type,
                      'remote_type', d.remote_type,
                      'hard_surface_install', d.hard_surface_install,
                      'ladder_over_15ft', d.ladder_over_15ft,
                      'requires_takedown', d.requires_takedown,
                      'unit_price', d.unit_price,
                      'notes', d.notes,
                      'options_json', d.options_json
                    )
                  )
                  ORDER BY d.variant
                )
                FROM public.sales_quote_designs d
                WHERE d.line_item_id = li.id
              ),
              '[]'::jsonb
            )
          )
        )
        ORDER BY COALESCE(li.sort_order, 0), li.created_at
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(li.quantity, 1)), 0)::integer,
    COALESCE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN li.product_type ILIKE '%shutter%' THEN COALESCE(li.quantity, 1) ELSE 0 END),
      0
    )::integer,
    COALESCE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN li.product_type NOT ILIKE '%shutter%' THEN COALESCE(li.quantity, 1) ELSE 0 END),
      0
    )::integer
  INTO v_line_items, v_total_products, v_shutter_count, v_blinds_shades_count
  FROM public.sales_quote_line_items li
  WHERE li.quote_id = NEW.id;

  v_product_type := CASE
    WHEN v_shutter_count > 0 AND v_blinds_shades_count > 0 THEN 'shutters_and_blinds'::public.product_type
    WHEN v_shutter_count > 0 THEN 'shutters'::public.product_type
    ELSE 'blinds_shades'::public.product_type
  END;

  IF NEW.created_job_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.jobs
    SET
      status = v_job_status,
      status_changed_at = v_now::text,
      product_received_at = COALESCE(v_product_received_at, product_received_at),
      product_type = v_product_type,
      customer_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.customer_name, ''), customer_name),
      customer_phone = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.customer_phone, ''), customer_phone),
      customer_email = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.customer_email, ''), customer_email),
      customer_address = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.customer_address, ''), customer_address),
      invoice_amount = COALESCE(NEW.total_amount, invoice_amount),
      sales_order_number = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.manufacturer_order_ref, ''), sales_order_number),
      ordered_date = COALESCE(NEW.ordered_at::date, ordered_date),
      line_items_detail = v_line_items::text,
      total_products = v_total_products,
      total_windows = v_total_products,
      num_items = v_total_products,
      number_of_shutters = v_shutter_count,
      num_shutters = v_shutter_count,
      number_of_blinds_shades = v_blinds_shades_count,
      num_blinds_shades = v_blinds_shades_count,
      technician_notes = CONCAT('Linked 805 quote ', NEW.quote_number),
      updated_at = v_now
    WHERE id = NEW.created_job_id
      AND account_id = v_805_account_id
    RETURNING id INTO v_job_id;

    IF v_job_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      INSERT INTO public.job_actions (job_id, action_type, performed_by_ai, details)
      VALUES (
        v_job_id,
        '805_quote_status_synced',
        true,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'quote_id', NEW.id,
          'quote_number', NEW.quote_number,
          'quote_status', NEW.status,
          'job_status', v_job_status,
          'manufacturer_order_ref', NEW.manufacturer_order_ref
        )
      );

      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  SELECT id
  INTO v_job_id
  FROM public.jobs
  WHERE account_id = v_805_account_id
    AND creation_method = '805_quote_sale'
    AND line_items_detail LIKE '%' || NEW.id::text || '%'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_job_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.jobs
    SET
      status = v_job_status,
      status_changed_at = v_now::text,
      product_received_at = COALESCE(v_product_received_at, product_received_at),
      product_type = v_product_type,
      customer_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.customer_name, ''), customer_name),
      customer_phone = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.customer_phone, ''), customer_phone),
      customer_email = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.customer_email, ''), customer_email),
      customer_address = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.customer_address, ''), customer_address),
      invoice_amount = COALESCE(NEW.total_amount, invoice_amount),
      sales_order_number = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.manufacturer_order_ref, ''), sales_order_number),
      ordered_date = COALESCE(NEW.ordered_at::date, ordered_date),
      line_items_detail = v_line_items::text,
      total_products = v_total_products,
      total_windows = v_total_products,
      num_items = v_total_products,
      number_of_shutters = v_shutter_count,
      num_shutters = v_shutter_count,
      number_of_blinds_shades = v_blinds_shades_count,
      num_blinds_shades = v_blinds_shades_count,
      technician_notes = CONCAT('Linked 805 quote ', NEW.quote_number),
      updated_at = v_now
    WHERE id = v_job_id;

    NEW.created_job_id := v_job_id;

    INSERT INTO public.job_actions (job_id, action_type, performed_by_ai, details)
    VALUES (
      v_job_id,
      '805_quote_customer_card_relinked',
      true,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'quote_id', NEW.id,
        'quote_number', NEW.quote_number,
        'quote_status', NEW.status,
        'job_status', v_job_status
      )
    );

    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('sync_805_quote_customer_card_number'));

  SELECT COALESCE(
    MAX(NULLIF(regexp_replace(split_part(job_number, '-', 1), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::bigint),
    0
  )
  INTO v_highest_num
  FROM public.jobs
  WHERE job_number IS NOT NULL;

  v_job_number :=
    lpad((v_highest_num + 1)::text, 4, '0')
    || '-'
    || right((extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint::text, 4);

  INSERT INTO public.jobs (
    job_number,
    account_id,
    status,
    status_changed_at,
    creation_method,
    job_type,
    product_type,
    customer_name,
    customer_phone,
    customer_email,
    customer_address,
    invoice_amount,
    sales_order_number,
    ordered_date,
    product_received_at,
    line_items_detail,
    total_products,
    total_windows,
    num_items,
    number_of_shutters,
    num_shutters,
    number_of_blinds_shades,
    num_blinds_shades,
    technician_notes,
    updated_at
  )
  VALUES (
    v_job_number,
    v_805_account_id,
    v_job_status,
    v_now::text,
    '805_quote_sale',
    'installation',
    v_product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.customer_name, ''), 'Unknown'),
    NULLIF(NEW.customer_phone, ''),
    NULLIF(NEW.customer_email, ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.customer_address, ''), 'Address Required'),
    NEW.total_amount,
    NULLIF(NEW.manufacturer_order_ref, ''),
    NEW.ordered_at::date,
    v_product_received_at,
    v_line_items::text,
    v_total_products,
    v_total_products,
    v_total_products,
    v_shutter_count,
    v_shutter_count,
    v_blinds_shades_count,
    v_blinds_shades_count,
    CONCAT('Linked 805 quote ', NEW.quote_number),
    v_now
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_job_id;

  NEW.created_job_id := v_job_id;

  INSERT INTO public.job_actions (job_id, action_type, performed_by_ai, details)
  VALUES (
    v_job_id,
    '805_quote_customer_card_created',
    true,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'quote_id', NEW.id,
      'quote_number', NEW.quote_number,
      'quote_status', NEW.status,
      'job_status', v_job_status,
      'manufacturer_order_ref', NEW.manufacturer_order_ref
    )
  );

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
